headline: THE 2.5970-EBPW BODY IS NOT CAPABILITY-DEAD: IT ANSWERS CORRECTLY ON A RAW PROMPT AND EMITS ONE <think> TOKEN THEN STOPS UNDER THE CHAT TEMPLATE
what_prompted_it: The operator asked what happened to the 2-EBPW body that ran 30+ TPS. QWEN_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION.json records it at 0/43, failing all seven axes. Every one of those 43 items is asked THROUGH THE CHAT TEMPLATE.

RAW_PROMPT.The capital of France is: Paris, and the capital of the United States is Washington, D.C.

mechanism: Under the chat template the body emits a single <think> token and then a stop token. It never enters the reasoning block, never closes it, and never reaches an answer. decode_steps=0 on the templated run with FALLBACKS=0 and no error.

throughput_raw_arm.note: NOT comparable to the 33.31/34.15/34.24 single_stream_tps in QWEN_PERFORMANCE_QUALIFICATION.json: different profile, prompt, token count and build. Quoting a regression from that pair would be the stale-baseline error this program has already sealed. Both are real; they measure different runs.

what_this_ESTABLISHES: The 0/43 capability score is NOT a pure capability measurement. It conflates the body's capability with a TEMPLATE INTERACTION that emits <think> and halts.
The body produces correct, coherent answers on 3 of 4 raw prompts with zero fallbacks.
The body, the fast runtime and the 8.2 GB artifact are all intact on disk. Nothing was lost.
what_this_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: What the body would score on the 43-item contract with a corrected template. That needs the suite re-run and has NOT been done. 3 of 4 greedy single-sample prompts is a REFUTATION of 'capability-dead', not a capability qualification.
That the body can do structured output, coding, or multi-turn work -- the code prompt `def add(a, b):` returned empty even on the raw arm.
Anything about the 3.1393-EBPW sealed body, which scores 30/43 through the same template and is therefore NOT affected the same way.
consequence: G004's retirement reasoning and G011 rest on the 0/43 number. That number's MEANING changes: it is a template-interaction result. The capability gate needs a raw-prompt control arm so a template incompatibility can never again be recorded as a capability verdict.

bench.machine: Apple M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 96 GiB (receipts/headless/MACHINE_GENOME.json)
bench.rule: S032 §3 -- if quiescence is unknown the state is UNKNOWN, not quiet
bench.provenance: this receipt was written before quiescence was a benchmark input and recorded none. UNKNOWN is what it measured under, not a claim that the machine was busy
